lessons.lesson: Cursor documents AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules/*.mdc as read by cloud agents from every entry point, but documents CLAUDE.md only for the CLI — anything that must fire unattended belongs in an alwaysApply rule and a short AGENTS.md summary, not in CLAUDE.md alone

summary: planned the three-phase pipeline: subagents with pinned models, an always-applied rule, an append-only ledger, and hooks to enforce all three

lessons.lesson: A hook that imports a module from scripts/ must set sys.dont_write_bytecode before the import: a stray scripts/__pycache__ makes every 'did this run change the repository' check answer yes, forever

summary: implemented the pipeline; the implement phase ran on Opus, not the pinned Sonnet — no Sonnet 5 slug was available to this environment's Task tool, and the deviation is on the record rather than mislabelled

lessons.lesson: pytest cannot collect anything in this repository without psycopg, because tests/conftest.py imports it at module scope — a proof script that must work on a clean clone runs pytest with --noconftest, or skips it out loud

summary: second implement entry: the proof had to run on a clean clone with nothing installed

lessons.lesson: When a hook decides whether a run changed the repository, compare against a baseline the run recorded at its own first hook — never against upstream or origin/main, which describe what earlier runs left on the branch, so they let a run that commits and pushes escape while nagging a run that touched…

summary: Opus verify pass 1: fail — 2 must-fix (no dated artefact with captured output; the rule restated the model ids it forbids restating) and 9 should-fix, including an exempt entry closing a run that changed the repo and three phase entries with no subagent behind them satisfying the stop hook

lessons.lesson: An enforcement rule a single ledger entry can satisfy is a suggestion: before trusting a gate, reach the state it exists to catch and try to close the run from there — exempt closed a run that had changed the repo, and three unattested phase entries closed one that never delegated anything

summary: addressed all 11 findings from verify pass 1, each with a check that fails if the fix is reverted

lessons.lesson: This environment's Task tool exposed no Sonnet 5 model slug, so the implement phase ran on Opus — check the available slugs before claiming a phase ran on its pinned model, and let the hook record the disagreement rather than writing the model you intended

summary: implement and verify were not delegated to their pinned models this run: no Sonnet 5 slug was available to this environment, and the verify phase ran as a general subagent on Opus 5, so subagentStart could not attest either phase

lessons.lesson: When you close a hole by making a rule stricter, run the honest path that rule protects all the way to the end — writing the ledger entry the protocol demands is itself a change to the repository, and a gate that punishes the compliant run is a worse bug than the one you closed

summary: Opus verify pass 2 on the fixes: fail — recording an exemption disqualified the run from it; amend, reset and rebase still finished silently; git() ignored exit codes so two tests and one proof check were comparing HEAD with itself

lessons.lesson: A git helper that returns stdout without checking the exit code hands you plausible rubbish: rev-parse HEAD prints "HEAD" and exits 128 in a repo with no commits, which made an ancestry check compare a commit with itself and pass

summary: fixed all of verify pass 2: ledger excluded from the authorship signal by pathspec, same-branch tip movement counts, git() honours exit codes, note --about replaces substring matching, session id escaped in the tamper alarm

lessons.evidence: verify pass 2 process note: HEAD moved three times during the review
lessons.lesson: A read-only checker cannot pin a verdict to a moving tree: tell it the commit you want reviewed, and if you fix something while it works, name the new HEAD when you ask for its report

summary: the verify phase ran twice as a general subagent on Opus 5, not the pinned verifier subagent, so subagentStart could not attest it; the branch also moved under the checker mid-review

lessons.evidence: scripts/agent_ledger.py cmd_append prints the resolved ledger path
lessons.lesson: Check where the ledger CLI is writing before trusting that it wrote: an exported CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR redirects it, and the success line looked identical — which is why append now prints the absolute path

summary: an exported CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR from earlier debugging silently sent three ledger entries to a scratch repository

lessons.evidence: git worktree add /tmp/mainwt origin/main && python3 -m pytest tests/bronze -q: 2 failed, 1 passed
lessons.lesson: The VDE-11 immutability tests are red on origin/main: src/extractors/postgres.py:65 TRUNCATEs bronze tables for test fixtures and the grep-based proof counts it as a mutation — check a failing test against origin/main before assuming your change caused it

summary: tests/bronze/test_immutability.py fails on origin/main, unrelated to this change — verified in a clean worktree of origin/main

lessons.lesson: README's build-log table conflicts on almost every merge because every branch appends a row to it — keep both rows in PR order, never pick a side; git log shows this same resolution at 239650f and e3d7a2f

summary: merged origin/main: one conflict, both sides appending a row to the README build-log table

lessons.lesson: CI that dbt-builds this repo must apply the DDL list in tests/integration/conftest.py _BRONZE_DDL, not the docker-compose mount list: compose also mounts sql/gold/*.sql, which pre-creates the gold tables dbt materialises, so dbt build fails on relation-already-exists

summary: planned VDE-50 CI: two GitHub Actions jobs (lint+mypy+unit, and integration+dbt build on a Postgres service container), a committed uv.lock with a pre-decided fallback ladder, a stdlib run_results.json guard, and scripts/prove_ci.sh that executes the guard's dbt-test-failure path offline

lessons.lesson: GitHub Actions postgres service containers start before checkout, so repository SQL cannot be volume-mounted into them — apply bronze DDL as an explicit workflow step after checkout

summary: plan phase ran via planner subagent on claude-opus-5; parent recorded ledger because planner shell was blocked

lessons.lesson: grep -qF with a variable that starts with a dash is parsed as a grep option even after -q -F; use Python for all string-in-file checks in proof scripts

summary: implemented GitHub Actions CI workflow (lint+mypy+unit / integration+dbt), check_dbt_results.py guard, prove_ci.sh, uv.lock (rung 1), mypy config with 6 overrides, artefact docs/2026-08-01-vde-50-github-actions-ci.md

lessons.evidence: README.md lines 421-426: #42 row named explicitly, VDE-50 row now links PR #44
lessons.lesson: when a build-log table grows by one row, any relative reference like 'that last row' in the paragraph below it silently shifts meaning — name the row by its unique identifier instead

summary: fixed README build-log prose: named the #42/ADR-013 row explicitly instead of 'that last row'; linked VDE-50 row to PR #44; updated docs artefact Actions URL placeholder

lessons.lesson: ruff --fix is idempotent: run it after every ruff check failure rather than hand-editing — it fixed E501 automatically as part of the I001 import-block reformatting in the same file

summary: fixed 5 pre-existing ruff findings (UP035 dbt_assets.py, I001 pipeline_runs.py conftest.py test_medallion_dag.py, E501 test_medallion_dag.py) with ruff --fix; updated artefact with Actions run 30683442782 per-job verdict and ruff follow-up table

lessons.evidence: ./scripts/prove_ci.sh exit 0; https://github.com/brunohart/cinema-ops-platform/actions/runs/30683958870 ruff success mypy success integration success
lessons.lesson: Standing up ruff in CI for the first time surfaces pre-existing findings the local suite never gated — run ruff check . on the branch before the first push, or the lint job fails for reasons unrelated to the issue

summary: verified VDE-50 CI: pass — all plan steps present; prove_ci.sh exit 0; Actions run 30683958870 has ruff+mypy green, integration green, unit red only on known VDE-11; DDL list matches _BRONZE_DDL; README prose must-fix and pre-existing ruff findings fixed after first verify

lessons.lesson: When a read-only phase subagent cannot write the ledger, the parent appends with the model that formed the verdict and a note naming the hatch — do not leave verify unrecorded

summary: verifier subagent (claude-opus-5) returned pass but could not append — parent recorded the verify entry from the subagent verdict plus parent-run prove_ci.sh and Actions evidence
